_note: Neutral sample fixtures for the live intent eval. Same kinds, aliases, descriptions, param_descriptions and previews as the Step 1 config.local.toml sample in plans/018. The Superhuman entries (superhuman_search_threads, superhuman_get_thread) are placeholders until Samay signs in and --mcp-tools shows the real read tools; replace the server tool names, schemas and param_descriptions then. Sample names only (Dana, Priya, Acme); no real people, addresses, accounts or note text.

today.description: Samay's must-do and should-do lines for today from his TODAY note, with which are done, plus reminders due today.
today.canned_result: Must do: 1. Email the landlord (open). 2. Dentist appointment (open). 3. Send Acme invoice (done). Reminders due today: none.

calendar.description: Samay's calendar events and open stretches for a day or date range. Work events show only as busy.

param_descriptions.end: last day, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 13 days after start

people.description: Who Samay owes a reply across personal email, texts and WhatsApp: name, channel, wait, and the one-line ask. Use first for any reply question.
people.canned_result: Dana (email, 2 days): asks about the offsite budget. Priya (text, 5 hours): wants dinner plans. Acme recruiter (email, 1 day): asks for availability.

thread.description: The latest texts or WhatsApp messages with one named person. Only when Samay asks about that person's messages.
thread.canned_result: Priya: Are we still on for Friday? Priya: I can do 7 or 8.

param_descriptions.person: the person's name as Samay said it

lookup.description: Weather (optional place) or sports results and schedule (optional team).
lookup.canned_result: Weather: 54F and clear, rain after 9pm. Sports: the home team won 101 to 96.

capture.description: Save one thought, note or log line to Samay's capture inbox. Only when he says capture, note, jot, or log.

param_descriptions.text: the thought exactly as Samay said it

remind.description: Add an Apple Reminder with a due time (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, local). Only when he asks to be reminded.

param_descriptions.title: what to be reminded of
param_descriptions.due: local time as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM; ask if Samay gave no time

strike.description: Mark one must-do or should-do line in today's note as done, matched by a few of its words.

param_descriptions.phrase: a few words from the line Samay finished

search_meetings.description: Find Samay's recorded Granola meetings by person, company, keyword or date.
search_meetings.canned_result: Acme pricing review, yesterday, with Dana. Acme kickoff, last Tuesday, with Priya.

search_transcripts.description: Find what was said in Samay's Granola meeting transcripts, by keywords and optional date range.
search_transcripts.canned_result: Pricing review: Dana proposed a flat annual fee. The group agreed to revisit in two weeks.

param_descriptions.query: words to find in what was said

search_meetings.description: Find Samay's Wispr Flow meeting notes by keyword, person or date.
search_meetings.canned_result: Acme sync, yesterday (id m_100): pricing discussion with Dana.

get_meeting.description: Read one Wispr Flow meeting's notes by id from wispr_search_meetings.
get_meeting.canned_result: Acme sync notes: Dana prefers a flat fee; follow up next week.

search_threads.description: PLACEHOLDER until sign-in. Search Samay's personal email threads by sender, subject or keyword.
search_threads.canned_result: Dana, Re: offsite budget, yesterday: Thanks, sending numbers tomorrow.

get_thread.description: PLACEHOLDER until sign-in. Read one personal email thread by id from superhuman_search_threads.
get_thread.canned_result: Dana: Thanks, sending numbers tomorrow. Samay: Sounds good.
